Info

Defines immutable ReplDispatchResult model capturing the outcome of dispatching a line in REPL.

class scaralang.core.model.repl.repl_dispatch_result.ReplDispatchResult(*, is_exit: bool, is_handled: bool, message: str)[source]¶

Bases: object

Immutable data model recording the outcome of a REPL command dispatch.

It defines:

attributes:
is_exit - True if the session termination command was requested.
is_handled - True if a built-in session command was executed.
message - Informational or diagnostic message from the dispatch.
is_exit: bool¶
is_handled: bool¶
